name: Scott Klug
bio: A Representative from Wisconsin; born in Milwaukee, Wis., January 16, 1953; attended private schools; B.A., Lawrence University, Appleton, Wis., 1975; M.J.S., Northwestern University, Evanston, Ill., 1976; M.B.A., University of Wisconsin, Madison, Wis., 1990; television anchor and reporter in Seattle, Wash., Washington, D.C., and Madison, Wis.; vice president for business development, investment firm; publisher; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Second and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 1991-January 3, 1999); was not a candidate for reelection in 1998 to the One Hundred Sixth Congress; is a resident of Madison, Wis.
